no_adcom_quote.quote: An Advisory Committee Meeting was not held to review the use of LdT for the treatment of chronic Hepatitis B in adults.

summary: No advisory committee meeting was convened to review NDA 22-011 (telbivudine/TYZEKA) for chronic hepatitis B. The Medical Review states the NDA was not presented to the Antiviral Drugs Advisory Committee because the Division felt non-inferiority was clearly established and safety was comparable to lamivudine (despite an emerging myopathy signal), and the administrative filing checklist records 'No AC meeting.' The only committee referenced is an earlier issue-oriented Antiviral Drugs Advisory Committee meeting on August 7, 2002 that addressed HBV trial-design and endpoint questions for the drug class generally, not a review of this application.
